# MathJax

This is the same bundled MathJax JavaScript extracted from V5.1, not a new dependency downloaded during the build. The bundle reports MathJax 3.2.1. It is licensed under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE.txt` and https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax.

The local SVG renderer avoids external font files or a CDN. Do not manually edit this minified dependency.
